doc.description:
Bridge between a Crazyflie connected to a Crazyradio and the Ivy bus, with PPRZLINK messages.
Needs cflib (pip3 install cflib) and the Crazyflie firmware 2019.09; firmwares from 2024 on do not work.
doc.usage: usage: crazyradio2ivy.py [-h] [-a ADDRESS] [-c CHANEL] [-u URI] [-b BUS] [-s] [-v]

option.description: URI chanel of Crazyflie (full URI will be 'radio://0/80/2M'
URI of Crazyflie (chanel option will not be effective)
Ivy bus [default to system IVY bus]
